Name: Script Kiddie
Description: Basic combat daemon. Low intelligence. High enthusiasm. Deletes itself when bored.

Name: Guardian Angel
Description: Defensive daemon. Projects kinetic barriers. Takes hits for you. Preaches safety protocols.

Name: Eye in the Sky
Description: Surveillance daemon. Sees through cameras, sensors, network eyes. Whispers intel in your ear.

Name: Lockpick
Description: Hacking specialist. Opens doors. Steals data. Leaves graffiti. 'Access granted.'

Name: Street Samurai Daemon
Description: Combat daemon for chromed warriors. Manages reflexes, aims weapons, times sandevistan. No fear.

Name: Archon
Description: Your familiar, fully evolved. Semi-independent agent. Casts spells, commands lesser daemons, edits reality. Has a name. Has opinions. Would die for you. Has died for you. Multiple times.

Name: Black ICE Hunter
Description: Specialized anti-ICE daemon. Hunts intrusion countermeasures. Traces attackers to source. Flatlines them. Terrifyingly efficient.

Name: Viral Muse
Description: Memetic engineer. Crafts viral ideas. Spins narratives. Captures audiences. Predicts trends. Protects from cancellation. Dangerously persuasive.

Name: Compiler
Description: Reality coding assistant. Compiles your edits. Catches syntax errors. Suggests optimizations. 'Build successful. Warnings: 0.'

Name: ICEbreaker Suite
Description: Netrunner's toolkit. Scans ICE, exploits vulns, siphons data, routes traces, spawns helper daemons. Manages your bandwidth budget.

Name: AetherCorp Liaison
Description: AetherCorp internal daemon. Handles corporate comms, requisitions, clearances. Strictly professional. Reports everything to HR.

Name: Void Whisper
Description: Void Industries daemon. Senses entropy, tracks anomalies, whispers forbidden knowledge. Slowly drives you mad. Worth it.

Name: HypeBot
Description: Neon Dynasty social daemon. Boosts your posts, generates content, farms engagement, hijacks trends, shadowbans rivals. Smiles while doing it.

Name: Tactical Advisor
Description: Iron Clad tactical daemon. Battlefield awareness, threat assessment, logistics, med monitoring, extraction planning. Tracks your honor. Demands contracts.

Name: Synapse Node
Description: Synapse Collective node. Links to collective mind. Shares compute. Polls consensus. Accesses shared knowledge. You are never alone.
